label: ЯХВЕ
speaker: God speaking to Moses
extra: YHWH is explicit covenantal divine name: Exodus3:15 God identifies His name, 6:2 God self identifies, 15:3 Moses and Israel sing YHWH His name. MT vocalization is a reading tradition, not proof of original pronunciation; distinguish Ehyeh first person, Yah short form and Greek Kyrios.

label: Эхье ашер Эхье
speaker: YHWH speaking to Moses
extra: Direct publisher LXX Rahlfs-Hanhart Ex3:14 Ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ὤν, Ὁ ὢν ἀπέσταλκέν με; MT אֶהְיֶה אֲשֶׁר אֶהְיֶה, Ex3:12 presence promise. John8:58 only ἐγὼ εἰμί, no ὁ ὤν. Linguistic/editorial distinctions do not negate Christian interpretation.

label: ЯХВЕ-Ире
extra: Genesis22:9 Abraham builds ALTAR, but 22:14 explicitly names PLACE. Gen22:8 and 22:14a יִרְאֶה Qal versus 22:14b יֵרָאֶה Niphal; NET offers competing 'provide/appear' renderings, not one settled etymology.

label: ЯХВЕ-Рафа
extra: Exodus15:26 participial 'your healer' (2ms) in conditional divine covenant speech after Mara; Jer17:14 petition 'heal me' is different verbal morphology and speaker. Neither scene formally coins a new independent personal name.

label: ЯХВЕ-Нисси
extra: Exodus17:15 Moses names altar, not God or Massah/Meribah place (17:7). LXX Rahlfs Ex17:15 Κύριός μου καταφυγή not literal 'banner'; v16 MT יד על כס יה vs LXX εν χειρι κρυφαια; hypothetical emendation כס→נס is not attested MT.

label: ЯХВЕ-Мекаддешкем
extra: Ex31:13 and Lev20:8 both divine first-person covenant predications, with מְקַדִּשְׁכֶם 2mp not a person-name or a 1cs experience quote; cannot transfer every Mosaic Sabbath application to NT church without separate exegesis.

label: ЯХВЕ-Рои
extra: Psalm23:1 YHWH is MY shepherd, root רעה, not Hagar's El Roi ראה; John10:11 Jesus explicitly says Ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ποιμὴν ὁ καλός, with Christological canonical relation not identical original language or independent third deity.

label: ЯХВЕ-Шалом
extra: Judges6:23 YHWH SPEAKS peace, 6:24 Gideon NAMES an altar, 6:25 references DIFFERENT Baal altar to destroy. No direct divine self-naming in 6:24.

verse: Jeremiah 23:6 (royal name); Jeremiah 33:16 (city name in MT; passage absent from Old Greek Jeremiah)
label: ЯХВЕ-Цидкену
extra: Identical string YHWH tsidqenu in 23:6 refers to male royal Davidic branch, 33:16 to Jerusalem female named city. MT 33:14–26 absent from Old Greek; no invented Greek equivalent.

label: ЯХВЕ-Шамма
extra: Explicit וְשֵׁם-הָעִיר = name of city; Yahweh is there is a city designation reflecting divine presence. Not personal divine name or equation of city with YHWH.

label: ЯХВЕ Саваоф
speaker: narrator
extra: Hosts title in worship at Shiloh, David's human battle context, heavenly seraphim's hymn, Zechariah oracle and Greek NT transliteration. Greek Σαβαὼθ is not σάββατον (Sabbath). No single context fully resolves historical title origin.

label: Элохим
speaker: Genesis narrative voice
extra: Gen1:1 morphologically plural אֱלֹהִים governs singular בָּרָא for one Creator; Ex20:2 MT / Eng20:3 same lexeme for other gods with plural adjective; Deut6:4 suffixed אֱלֹהֵינוּ. Morphology alone neither proves Trinity nor multiple creators.

label: Эль
speaker: YHWH proclamation, narrator describing scene
extra: El is noun meaning god/God: Ex34:6, Deut32:4 and Isa43:12 positive YHWH referent; Deut32:12 and Isa43:10 negated foreign/possible god referent, NOT YHWH. Two lexical occurrences in Isa43 same chapter have opposite referent roles.

label: Эль Шаддай
speaker: YHWH
extra: Divine self-identification vs Isaac's benediction vs retrospective revelation. Mechon-Mamre shows שַׁדַּי in Genesis and שַׁדָּי in Exodus 6:3; preserve edition-specific points and don't attribute an unverified etymology or phonetic explanation.

label: Эль Элион
speaker: narrator
extra: MT Gen 14:22 joins YHWH and El Elyon in Abram's oath. Cargill 2019 hypothesis of a later gloss is secondary scholarship, not a verified manuscript variant here.

label: Эль Олам
speaker: Abraham
extra: Genesis 21:31 names Beer-sheba as place; 21:33 Abraham invokes YHWH, El Olam. The latter is not another name of the place.

label: Эль Рои
speaker: Hagar
extra: Narrator explicitly says וַתִּקְרָא שֵׁם־יְהוָה: Hagar calls the name of YHWH in 16:13. Verse 14 separately names the well. Do not wrongly assert no divine naming occurs; classification as permanent proper name is open.

label: Эль Гиббор
extra: Isa9:5 MT royal naming context (English 9:6), interpretation of who bears each title disputed between Jewish and Christian traditions. Isa10:21 God is the explicit recipient of a remnant's return. Preposition אֶל- not silently removed.

label: Эль Бет-Эль
speaker: Jacob
extra: Jacob builds an altar, but names the PLACE (לַמָּקוֹם), not the altar. Gen 28:19 and 35:15 independently name Beth-El.

label: Эль-Канна
speaker: YHWH in divine speech to Moses, third-person self-reference
referent: YHWH rejecting worship of other gods
extra: Ex34:14 explicitly includes קַנָּא שְׁמוֹ and אֵל קַנָּא; Deut4:24 is a covenant-warning descriptive epithet. Do not erase divine naming clause or make every adjective a new etymologically independent proper name.

label: Адонай
speaker: Moses addressing God, two tokens in one verse
extra: Adonai direct address in Exodus34, Isaiah narrative vision, Psalm8 has אֲדֹנֵינוּ possessive, Genesis23 human honorific אֲדֹנִי. Same broad semantic family does not guarantee identical pointed form or divine referent.

label: Святой Израилев
speaker: Isaiah prophetic accusation
referent: YHWH, Holy One of Israel, despised by nation
extra: Isa1:4 object of rejection with את marker, Isa43:3 explicit YHWH first-person self-description, Isa47:4 adjoining Redeemer and YHWH of hosts with edition punctuation. Editorial punctuation is not manuscript lexical segmentation.

label: Цур / Скала
speaker: Moses, Song of Moses
extra: The same צור lemma appears in positive metaphors of YHWH and ironic references to another people's rock/foreign gods. Never classify all occurrences as direct personal names of YHWH; Deut32:31 is mixed and 32:37 negative.

label: Авва
speaker: Jesus praying in Gethsemane
extra: SBLGNT three occurrences same Greek transcription Αββα ὁ πατήρ but Mark Jesus prays, Rom believers cry κράζομεν, Gal Spirit of Son cries κρᾶζον. Article+nominative πατήρ functions as address; Aramaic derivation not separate manuscript in Hebrew script. English daddy exclusive lexical claim not established from Barr abstract.

label: Эго эйми / Я есмь
speaker: Jesus
extra: John9:9 healed man uses exact Ἐγώ εἰμι while John8:58 Jesus places ἐγὼ εἰμί alongside πρὶν Ἀβραὰμ γενέσθαι. Lexical two-word formula itself not unique divine name; Christology rests on context/intertext, not exact quote of LXX Ex3:14 Ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ὤν. John18:5,6,8 repeated identity answers.

label: Эммануил
extra: Isaiah 7:14 child-naming; 8:8 name invocation/allusion; 8:10 assertion for God with us; Matthew 1:23 Christian citation with 3pl καλέσουσιν and Greek gloss. MT naming verb וְקָרָאת grammatically debated; Matthew cannot be copied into MT. Rahlfs-Hanhart 2006 LXX Isaiah 7:14 prints καλέσεις (2sg) as compared with SBLGNT Matthew 1:23 καλέσουσιν (3pl); direct digital editions checked, underlying textual apparatus not collated.

label: Ях / Йах
extra: Краткая форма божественного имени, отдельно от тетраграмматона. См. повтор во Пс. 68:5 (еврейская нумерация).

label: Элоах
referent: God who made Jeshurun; rejected by Jeshurun
extra: Форма существительного God; историческая деривация от אל/אלהים неоднозначна, её не выводить только из сходства.

label: Элах Шемайя / Бог Небес
referent: God of heaven, prayed to by Daniel and companions
extra: Арамейское обозначение. Не вставлять автоматически в еврейский словарь без языковой пометы.

label: Бог живой
referent: living God, object of soul's thirst
extra: Форма в стихе с предлогом לְ; при цитировании нельзя молча выдавать לְאֵל за אֵל.

label: Отец наш
extra: Полная синтаксическая конструкция с прямым обращением. Именование Отцом засвидетельствовано в ВЗ задолго до новозаветного Авва.

label: ЯХВЕ — свет мой
referent: YHWH as my light and salvation
extra: Не превращать два образных предиката в самостоятельное имя «ЯХВЕ-Ори».

label: Бог верный
extra: Контекст поэтической характеристики Бога; а не новый эквивалент тетраграмматона.

label: Бог милосердный и милостивый
extra: В собственном раскрытии Бога в Исх. 34:6; связь с другими исповедальными формулами отдельно верифицировать.

label: Господь Бог
referent: Lord God, grammatical agent of δώσει; distinct from recipient Jesus
extra: Говорящий в повествовании — ангел Гавриил, обращающийся к Марии (Лк. 1:26,30). В ст. 32 κύριος ὁ θεὸς — грамматический субъект дώσει; αὐτῷ — Иисус, получатель престола Давида. Не отождествлять narratorial speaker (Гавриил), grammatical agent (Бог) и recipient (Иисус). Отнесение Бога к Отцу — богословское/контекстуальное толкование, а не идентичность одного поля speaker.

label: Добрый Пастырь
extra: Самоописание Иисуса в полной фразе Ἐγώ εἰμι ...; не то же самое, что абсолютное ἐγώ εἰμι Ин. 8:58.

label: Воскресение и жизнь
referent: Jesus, the Resurrection and the Life
extra: У Иисуса есть грамматический предикат после Ἐγώ εἰμι, в отличие от Ин. 8:58.

form: ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἦν καὶ ὁ ἐρχόμενος
label: Тот, Кто есть, был и грядёт
speaker: the One who is/was/is coming, separately listed from Jesus Christ in 1:5
surface: ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἦν καὶ ὁ ἐρχόμενος
extra: Rev 1:4–5: John offers greeting ἀπὸ the One who is/was/is coming, then ἀπὸ seven spirits, then ἀπὸ Jesus Christ; referents are grammatically distinguished. Preserve odd ἀπὸ ὁ ὢν (nominative article after preposition). Rev 1:8 applies formula to speaker κύριος, ὁ θεός. Allusion to LXX Exod 3:14 is interpretive, not complete verbal identity.

label: Начало и конец
speaker: the one seated upon throne, introduced at Revelation 21:5
extra: SBLGNT Rev21:6 and Rev22:13 contain ἡ ἀρχὴ καὶ τὸ τέλος. In Rev1:8 SBLGNT lacks this clause, TR1550 contains αρχη και τελος. Rev21:6 SBLGNT has ἐγὼ without εἰμι; THGNT and TR1550 include the verb. In Rev22:13 speaker identification through 22:16 is a contextual inference with intervening angelic voice, not explicit attribution in v13.
